custom_data_process_wrapper

Source: R/custom_data_process_wrapper.R
custom_data_process_wrapper.Rd

Load, Process, and Optionally Override All Model Input Data

Usage

custom_data_process_wrapper(
  iso,
  disease,
  R0,
  cfr_off = TRUE,
  year_start = "",
  year_end = "",
  WHO_seed_switch = TRUE,
  aggregate_age = TRUE,
  new_age_breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80,
    Inf),
  transmission_history = c("circulating_years", "reported_cases_only"),
  circulation_threshold = 2,
  reporting_fraction = 1,
  coverage_accuracy = 1,
  vaccine_waning = "default",
  coverage_source = c("wuenic", "median"),
  seed_floor = 10,
  dtp_boosters = TRUE,
  booster_since = 1980,
  pertussis_vaccine = c("schedule", "acellular", "whole_cell"),
  custom_migration = NA,
  custom_fertility = NA,
  custom_mortality = NA,
  custom_population = NA,
  custom_contact_matricies = NA,
  custom_routine_vaccination = NA,
  custom_sia_vaccination = NA,
  custom_disease_data = NA,
  custom_vaccination_schedule = NA,
  custom_disease_parameters = NA,
  custom_vaccine_parameters = NA
)

Arguments

iso

A 3-letter ISO country code identifying the country for analysis (e.g., "ETH" for Ethiopia).

disease

A character string specifying the disease of interest (e.g., "measles", "diphtheria", "pertussis").

R0

The basic reproduction number while transmission is on (a single number).

cfr_off

Logical; Sets the CFR to zero. Used when calculating current susceptibility as prior mortality rates will already include disease specific mortality.

year_start

Optional numeric value specifying the first year of the simulation window. Default ("") uses the earliest available data year.

year_end

Optional numeric value specifying the last year of the simulation window. Default ("") uses the latest available data year.

WHO_seed_switch

Deprecated. `FALSE` (transmission throughout, as in 0.1.0) is now `transmission_history = "circulating_years"` with `circulation_threshold = 0`, and gives a warning.

aggregate_age

Logical; aggregate data from single-year age groups into custom intervals (default TRUE).

new_age_breaks

Numeric vector; breakpoints for age group aggregation. Default is c(0, 5, ..., Inf).

transmission_history

The assumption about how reported cases relate to true infections over the historical period: `"circulating_years"` (default), `"reported_cases_only"` (the assumption 0.1.0 made: case reporting is complete). See the section below.

circulation_threshold

Under `"circulating_years"`, the reported cases per million people per year at or above which the disease is taken to be circulating. Default 2; 0 keeps transmission on throughout.

reporting_fraction

Share of infections that are reported, used to scale the seeded infections (reported cases divided by this). A single number, or a vector named by year. Default 1.

coverage_accuracy

Multiplier on the odds of being vaccinated, to represent true coverage differing from reported coverage. 1 (default) takes reported coverage at face value; 2 halves the unvaccinated share when coverage is high; 0.5 roughly doubles it.

vaccine_waning

`"default"` (no waning of measles vaccine protection; the vaccine parameter table for other diseases), `"table"` (the table for every disease, as in 0.1.0) or `"none"`. See [resolve_vaccine_waning()].

coverage_source

`"wuenic"` (default) or `"median"`; see [process_vaccination_routine()].

seed_floor

Minimum number of infections introduced each year under `"circulating_years"`. Default 10.

dtp_boosters

Logical; for diphtheria and pertussis, give the booster doses in the country's WHO schedule as doses 4 to 6 (default `TRUE`). See [dtp_booster_schedule()]. `FALSE` gives the three-dose primary series only, as in 0.2.0.

booster_since

First year boosters are given before their coverage data start in 2018 (default 1980). See [backfill_booster_coverage()].

pertussis_vaccine

`"schedule"` (default: whole-cell or acellular as in the country's WHO schedule, see [pertussis_vaccine_type()]), `"acellular"` or `"whole_cell"`. Sets which primary-series row of the vaccine parameter table pertussis uses.

custom_migration

Optional. Data frame to override default migration data.

custom_fertility

Optional. Data frame to override default fertility data.

custom_mortality

Optional. Data frame to override default mortality data.

custom_population

Optional. Data frame to override default population (total) data.

custom_contact_matricies

Optional. Data frame to override default contact matrix data.

custom_routine_vaccination

Optional. Data frame to override default routine vaccination data.

custom_sia_vaccination

Optional. Data frame to override default SIA vaccination data.

custom_disease_data

Optional. Data frame to override default disease surveillance data.

custom_vaccination_schedule

Optional. Data frame to override default vaccination schedule.

custom_disease_parameters

Optional. Data frame to override default disease parameter values.

custom_vaccine_parameters

Optional. Data frame to override default vaccine parameter values.

Value

A named list containing structured parameters ready for use in the PREVAIL dynamic transmission model.

Details

This wrapper function loads internal datasets and processes them into structured model input parameters for a specified country, disease, and vaccine. Compared to data_load_process_wrapper, this function allows users to override any internal demographic, vaccination, or disease dataset with a custom data frame provided through the custom_* arguments. All data are formatted appropriately for use in the dynamic transmission model within PREVAIL.

Any custom_* argument can be used to override the corresponding internal dataset with a user-supplied data frame. If provided (not NA), these inputs are reformatted as needed and replace the matching internal dataset for this model run.

If any custom_* argument is provided, it replaces the corresponding PREVAIL internal dataset for that run. Demographic custom data is reformatted with reformat_demographic_data before use.

Demographic data (UN WPP) end before the present day; the last year with data is carried forward to `year_end`. Routine coverage is likewise carried forward from its last year with data.

The returned list also carries `history`, which is not used by the model: the reporting assumption, reported cases, seeded infections and transmission status by year, routine coverage and scheduled age by dose and year, and the protection and waning assigned to each vaccination stratum.

Reporting assumptions

WHO case reports badly under-count infections in most settings, but how badly is not known. Until reporting fractions are estimated (for example from seroprevalence surveys) the history has to be run under an assumption, chosen with `transmission_history`:

`"circulating_years"`

Reported cases are taken as evidence of whether the disease was circulating, not of how many infections there were. Transmission is on (at `R0`) in every year with at least `circulation_threshold` reported cases per million people, and in every year before reporting starts; it is off in years with fewer. A year with no report keeps the status of the year before. Pertussis is treated as circulating in every year, because it circulates everywhere whether or not it is reported. Reported cases (divided by `reporting_fraction`), and never fewer than `seed_floor` infections, are introduced on the first day of each year so that infection can return after fade-out. The number of infections is whatever the model implies. With `circulation_threshold = 0` transmission is on throughout (what `WHO_seed_switch = FALSE` meant in 0.1.0).

`"reported_cases_only"`

Case reporting and reported vaccination are taken as complete. Transmission runs at `R0` until the first year with a reported case and is switched off from then on; after that the only infections are the reported cases (divided by `reporting_fraction`), introduced on the first day of each year. This is the assumption PREVAIL 0.1.0 made, with `reporting_fraction = 1`.

Seeded infections enter the exposed compartment, placed across ages and vaccination strata in proportion to the effective number of susceptibles on the day.

`reporting_fraction` is where an estimated reporting level slots in: seeded infections are the reported cases divided by it. It can be a single number or a vector named by year (years without a name take the value of the nearest named year).
